title: Deel pricing - $29/employee/month Global Payroll up to $899 PEPM Enterprise EOR
clean_text: Deel's published 2026 pricing: standard EOR is $599 per employee per month (PEPM) and enterprise EOR is $899 PEPM, on top of which employer taxes (15-45% of salary depending on country), FX spreads (0.5-2% per payroll cycle), and a refundable deposit of 1-1.5x monthly cost apply. Global Payroll (for companies with their own legal entities already) costs $29/employee/month. Contractor management costs $49 per contractor per month (PCM) and Contractor of Record costs $325 PCM. Deel HR is free for up to 200 employees. Immigration/visa support is custom-priced, with third-party estimates around $300-$500/month per sponsored employee.
